text:
You need your websites submitted to at least 100 AI tools directories, and I can help you get that done accurately and efficiently.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience working with data-focused tasks that require accuracy, organization, and attention to detail. While my background is in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard work, data cleaning, and data visualization, the same strengths apply directly to directory submission work: careful tracking, clean record-keeping, consistent follow-through, and making sure nothing gets missed.

For a project like this, I would approach it in a structured way. I would organize the directories, track submission status, keep the website details consistent across each entry, and make sure the process stays orderly from the first submission through the last. Since directory submissions can involve repetitive steps and a lot of detail, I focus on staying precise and methodical so the work is completed properly.

I understand that your goal is not just volume, but getting the websites submitted to as many relevant AI tools directories as possible within the scope of the job. I can help with that by handling the data entry carefully and maintaining a clear submission workflow. If needed, I can also keep a simple tracking sheet so you can review progress easily and see what has been submitted.

My working style is dependable, organized, and detail-oriented. I’m comfortable with repetitive tasks that require consistency, and I make sure information is entered cleanly and accurately. That makes me a strong fit for submission-based SEO support where precision matters.

If you’d like, I can get started right away and help move your directory submissions forward in a structured and efficient way.
